name: Cosmos Server Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free-to-use self-hosted Docker server manager with app installation, authentication and reverse proxy; no managed hosting, infrastructure allowance or vendor quota is included.
watch_out: Source-available under Apache-2.0 with Commons Clause 1.0 AND an Anti Tampering Clause, not unrestricted open source. Selling Cosmos, derivatives or a Cosmos-based SaaS/PaaS is prohibited; upstream permits hosting a monetized business website if the business is not selling Cosmos features. Do not bypass licensing/paywall restrictions. Requires user-funded server, Docker socket privileges, storage, network and secure operations; review license terms for any commercial deployment or redistribution.
